title: Evaluating Online Bandit Exploration In Large-Scale Recommender System
reasoning: The paper discusses 'fair evaluation' and 'unfair evaluation' in the context of A/B testing methodology to ensure accurate performance measurement of bandit algorithms. While fairness is related to ethics, the discussion is limited to the technical fairness of the experiment design to prevent data leakage and ensure proper comparison, rather than evaluating or benchmarking broader ethical implications, moral content, or religious aspects of the recommender system itself or its outputs.
